public-source.scope: .reference-site plus stored body_class and source-* identifier
public-source.authority: Ordered document styles and public/reference/page-*.css; source theme, plugin, and local font assets
public-source.note: Widget overrides and route-specific source CSS take precedence over sampled tokens.

partnership.note: Independent black/gold treatment; preserve source colors and layout.

admin.note: Existing paper/green management interface; no public redesign authority.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Runtime CSS disables source animations and transitions; slider speed becomes zero.

evidence.method: Code inspection and bounded source CSS samples

components.name: Admin Primary Button
components.description: Management action only; public buttons retain source styles.

components.name: Public Migration Skip Link
components.description: Keyboard entry to source content without replacing source navigation.

narrative.overview: Recreate the source website across its public pages, preserving its content, composition, imagery, and route-specific styling. The public visual authority is the imported HTML and local source CSS, not the former green-and-cream reinterpretation. The management interface is independent and scoped beneath .admin-ui.
dos: Do use the affected document's source CSS and asset mappings as visual authority.
Do preserve original body classes, source identifiers, stylesheet order, content, and imagery.
Do keep public migration overrides and administrative styles separately scoped.
Do preserve keyboard access, reduced-motion behavior, and clear save/upload feedback.
donts: Don't replace route-specific public styles with one invented palette or spacing system.
Don't apply the former editorial public redesign to source pages.
Don't claim visual verification from code inspection.
